title: Orbital Relay Handshake
text: The orbital relay service issues a rotating badge token once per session. Operators rotate the badge every four hours. The audit log records badge issuance events but never records badge values.

title: Ferrite Ledger Compaction
text: The ferrite ledger compacts shards nightly. Compaction merges small shards into larger ones and rejects any shard whose checksum differs. A rejected shard is quarantined for manual review.

title: Kestrel Queue Backpressure
text: Kestrel queues apply backpressure when pending jobs exceed eight hundred. Producers receive a retry hint carrying a jittered delay. Consumers scale by adding worker lanes.

title: Marigold Snapshot Retention
text: Marigold snapshots are retained for thirty days. Restoring a snapshot requires two approvers. Every restore is written to the change journal together with the requesting team name.

title: Basalt Firewall Rule Audit
text: Basalt firewall rules are reviewed quarterly. Rules without an owner are flagged. The audit exports a table of rule identifiers and last-match timestamps.

title: Cinder Telemetry Sampling
text: Cinder telemetry samples one in fifty requests. Sampled traces include span identifiers and service names. Sampling density can be raised during incident review.

title: Harbor Certificate Renewal
text: Harbor certificates renew automatically fourteen days before expiry. A renewal failure raises a ticket to the platform desk. Manual renewal needs an approved maintenance window.

title: Willow Cache Eviction
text: Willow caches evict the least recently used entry when occupancy exceeds ninety percent. Each eviction increments a counter exposed on the metrics endpoint.

title: Tundra Batch Scheduler
text: The tundra scheduler runs batch jobs in windows between midnight and four. A job that exceeds its window is paused and resumed the following night.

title: Compass Config Drift
text: Compass compares deployed configuration against the repository every hour. Drift produces a report listing line differences and the deploying commit identifier.

title: Lantern Session Revocation
text: Lantern revokes sessions when a user role changes. Revocation propagates within sixty seconds. A stale session is rejected at the gateway.

title: Quarry Index Rebuild
text: Quarry rebuilds its search index weekly. Rebuilds run against a read replica. The rebuild records document counts and the elapsed duration.
